theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdr_dual_dist
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ κ u) → ∀ x y : Euclid P, (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x i - y i = k) → infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} ≤ Real.sqrt (m + 2) * κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
